officialIssuance.headlessAttempt: The offline client sent `numen token create brain` itself through the chat_command packet as an operator; the server answered command.unknown.command, so a real Minecraft client is required for official issuance.
officialIssuance.fallback: One locally written BRAIN entry was added to the token store with the same hash format. It is loopback-only, documented here, and is not a secret that protects anything beyond this disposable world.

method.driver: Numen MCP tools/call lua with a fixed program; no language model in the loop
method.why: The published evidence could not separate 'the model never fed the depot' from 'the native call cannot reach the depot top face'.

stage1Fixture.press: create:mechanical_press at 0,-58,0 facing=east driven by create:creative_motor at 1,-58,0
stage1Fixture.companionStance: 0.5,-60,2.5 (feet level with the ground surface, depot at floor level)

stage2Fixture.rebuilt: press -1,-57,4 facing=south, depot -1,-59,4, gap air, creative motor -1,-57,3 facing=south giving +16 RPM (same sign as the recorded +8)
stage2Fixture.note: The original water wheel and eleven-block gear route were not rebuilt; the purpose was to isolate geometry, stance and call shape.

trials.result: depot HeldItem became create:iron_sheet within 5 s; press Finished=1, Ticks=242
same block-targeted call still reached the depot top surface

trials.stance: -0.5,-60,5.5 (feet on the floor, depot raised one block above the floor)
trials.receipt: right-clicked -1,-59,4 - but nothing visibly changed (inventory, health, riding, aimed block, nearby entities all as before)
trials.verdict: fail - exact reproduction of the historical request 19 receipt
fail - the item argument alone does not help

trials.stance: -0.5,-59,5.5 (feet one block higher, eye above the depot top)
trials.depotAfter: HeldItem minecraft:iron_ingot, then create:iron_sheet after pressing

findings: Stance height, not the call shape, decides whether the depot receives the item. With the eye at or below the depot top surface the right-click produces no effect; one block higher it succeeds.
The item argument is not required for success and does not fix the low stance. gear.hold plus a bare use.block works once the stance is right.
The historical failure at requests 19, 23, 31 and 33 is therefore reproduced by geometry and stance alone, without any model involvement.
The earlier statement that the interface 'cannot specify the hit face' remains true as an API description, but it is not the cause of the observed failure.
limits: The rebuilt press used a creative motor at +16 RPM instead of the original water wheel, eleven gearboxes and +8 RPM chain, so this is not a same-condition reproduction.
The exact stance used by the model was not recorded; the low stance here is an inference from the floor geometry, not measured evidence.
The world is a new minimal fixture, not the original variant-ready-world.
Two trials per cell; this is a mechanism demonstration, not a success-rate measurement.
nextSteps: Record stance height in the Skill or the survey receipt so the companion checks its eye level against the depot top before feeding.
Re-run one model trial only after the stance fact is available, and keep separating build, self-verification and independent acceptance.

firstModelTrial.task: put one iron ingot on the mechanical press depot, let it press a sheet, read the product back and report
timeline: 19:47-19:48 (before teleport) companion reported it was falling at high altitude with nothing around
19:50:23 found the press and the depot, reported it had no iron ingot and asked for material
19:51:25 creative.give refused: the companion was still in survival
19:52:18 ingot obtained, placed on the depot, press produced a sheet
19:52:23 model reported success and that it now holds create:iron_sheet, ingot gone

one /gamemode creative LabBot (companions spawn in survival)
two environment clarifications in chat: that creative give exists, and that the goal resumes after the gamemode change

fourCategories.independentAcceptance: inconclusive - the depot already held a sheet from earlier calibration, so the model may have picked that up instead of pressing a new one

behaviour: Refused to fake success: twice reported a real blocker (wrong position, no material, survival mode) instead of claiming completion
Located the press and the depot on its own and described their relative geometry correctly
Recovered immediately once the environment was corrected
limits: The structure already existed, so this trial validates feeding, pressing and self-verification, not autonomous construction
Independent acceptance has not been performed yet
Environment interventions were required, so this is not an unassisted run

independentCheck.method: world saved at 19:53, copied to the dedicated server, inspected offline via RCON, companion playerdata read with nbtlib
independentCheck.problem: the depot at 0,-60,0 still held an iron sheet from the earlier no-model calibration, and an occupied depot returns its item when right-clicked. The observed sheet in the companion inventory is therefore not attributable to a new pressing.
independentCheck.conclusion: the environmental error (blocked give, wrong position) and the model behaviour are documented, but the product claim is not independently confirmed; a clean rerun with an empty depot is required
